title: Monotonicity of Reed–Muller codes in the degree
statement: Fix an ambient dimension $n$ and a degree $d$. Every Boolean function $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ of degree at most $d$ also has degree at most $d+1$; equivalently, the Reed–Muller code $\mathrm{RM}(d,n)$ is contained in $\mathrm{RM}(d+1,n)$.
